limitations.note: The patch fixed the shift direction but replaced the registered comparison with a combinational one, making match assert and deassert one clock earlier than the original design.
The test used the just-updated history to predict match, so it passed the new timing rather than checking that match still reflected the pre-edge window.

limitations.quote: Both the submitted fix and the reference used `{a_tem[7:0], a}` as the sole change.
